properties.displayName: [AZ-06] Audit public IP addresses attached to VMs
properties.description: Audits Microsoft.Network/publicIPAddresses with a public ipAddress. The NIC-to-NSG correlation is a cross-resource check reproduced against fixtures by run.py (azure/arg/AZ-06.kql). Known false positive: VMs behind Azure Firewall — a deliberate miss; firewall presence is a separate detection.
